name: Heabler Metal Products
old_description: With decades of expertise and a reputation of excellence, Heabler Metal Products offers everything from small repairs and custom prototype fabrication to large-scale component manufacturing and complex assemblies.
about:
Heabler Metal Products operates from Denver, Colorado. The company emphasizes decades of expertise in metal fabrication, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides a wide range of metalworking services, including sheet metal shearing (up to 3/16-inch thickness by 10-foot length), CNC plasma cutting, 3D modeling, pipe and tube bending, and multiple welding processes (TIG, MIG, spot, and stick). Additional capabilities cover sawing and cutting, repair services, 13-foot CNC forming, and 4-foot rolling. Heabler handles projects from small repairs and custom prototypes to large-scale component manufacturing and complex assemblies, following a three-step process of quote request, estimation, and fabrication.

Heabler serves customers requiring custom metal fabrication across various project scales, but specific industry sectors or named clients are not listed in its public materials.

The company highlights its reputation for excellence and a full-service approach that spans quoting, estimation, and fabrication, with a particular emphasis on repair work alongside new production.
